count_dracula: The ancient Transylvanian nobleman and vampire who sets out to colonise modern London, an old-world predator moving into the age of railways and typewriters. After the opening chapters he is rarely seen directly; he is pieced together from everyone else's records, and his attack on Mina turns him from hunter into hunted.
abraham_van_helsing: Seward's old teacher from Amsterdam, a doctor and scientist who also takes folklore and faith seriously. He is the one who can name the threat and knows how to fight it, and he leads the band of hunters, intellectually and morally.
lucy_westenra: Mina's warm, much-courted friend and the Count's first victim in England. Her slow death, return as the "bloofer lady" and final destruction show what vampirism really does, convince the doubters, and bind the men who loved her into the band that hunts the Count.
mina_harker: Born Wilhelmina Murray, Jonathan's fiancee and then wife, and the novel's real organiser: she types up and orders the diaries, letters and cuttings that make up the book, and spots the clues the men miss. After the Count forces his blood on her, the bond between them becomes the hunters' best way of tracking him.
jonathan_harker: The young Exeter solicitor whose journal of imprisonment in Castle Dracula opens the novel and first warns of the threat. He goes from naive clerk to hardened hunter, and at the end it is his knife that cuts the Count's throat as Quincey's pierces his heart.
arthur_holmwood: Lucy's fiance, who becomes Lord Godalming when his father dies. He gives Lucy his blood and later drives the stake through her heart, the story's emotional climax; his title and money then open doors throughout the hunt.
john_seward: A young doctor who runs the asylum beside Carfax and one of Lucy's suitors. A modern man of science who records his diary on a phonograph, he has to be talked out of his scepticism, and his notes on his patient Renfield chart the Count's movements before anyone understands them.
quincey_morris: A rich, brave Texan, another of Lucy's suitors and a loyal friend to Arthur and Seward. Practical and plain-spoken, he drives his bowie knife into the Count's heart in the final fight but is mortally wounded, and the Harkers name their son after him.
rm_renfield: A patient in Seward's asylum who eats flies, spiders and birds to absorb their lives, and who calls the Count "Master". His moods act as a barometer of the Count's nearness; he lets the Count in, then turns against him to protect Mina and is killed for it.
peter_hawkins: Jonathan's employer, an Exeter solicitor who sends him to Transylvania and so sets the plot moving. A fatherly figure to Jonathan and Mina, he dies early on and leaves Jonathan his business and fortune.
mrs_westenra: Lucy's mother, a widow with a weak heart. Loving but kept in the dark, she undoes Van Helsing's protections by removing the garlic from Lucy's room, and dies of fright the night the wolf breaks in, leaving Lucy defenceless.
petrof_skinsky: A trader in Galatz who deals with the Slovaks and is hired to receive the Count's box from the ship. Once he has passed it on he is found with his throat torn open: the Count covering his tracks.
sam_bloxam: A London carrier who moved nine of the Count's boxes from Carfax to a house in Piccadilly, helped by an old man of uncanny strength. Seward's hunt for him leads the band to the Count's main London lair.
thomas_bilder: The keeper of the wolves at the Zoological Gardens, whose chatty newspaper interview about Bersicker's escape gives an outsider's glimpse of the Count's power over animals. Its comic tone sits beside the horror of the same night, when the wolf breaks into Lucy's room.
joseph_smollet: A carrier's man in Walworth who helped move the Count's boxes and remembers where some of them went, giving the hunters the addresses of more of the Count's hiding places.
mr_swales: An elderly Whitby sailor who scoffs to Mina and Lucy about the lies carved on the tombstones, a wry note on how far written records can be trusted in a novel made of them. He senses his own death coming, and is found dead of fright on their seat the night the Count lands.
samuel_billington: A Whitby solicitor to whom the Count's boxes of earth are consigned when they arrive on the Demeter. His firm's paperwork lets the hunters trace the boxes on to Carfax.
donelson: Captain of the Czarina Catherine, the ship that carries the Count's box from London to Galatz. His account of an uncannily fast voyage, and of a crew who wanted the box thrown overboard, shows the Count's hold over wind and fog.
immanuel_hildesheim: A shipping agent in Galatz who signed for the Count's box and handed it on to Petrof Skinsky.
mary: A servant in the Harkers' house in Exeter, who shows Van Helsing in when he first calls on Mina.
sister_agatha: A nun at the hospital in Buda-Pesth who nurses Jonathan through brain fever after his escape. Her letter ends Mina's weeks of not knowing where he was and brings her to Buda-Pesth, where they marry.
enoch: Not a character: the biblical Enoch, who "walked with God", to whom Renfield grandly compares himself.
geordie: Swales's name for George Canon, a Whitby suicide whose tombstone claims a pious mother's grief. Lucy's favourite seat in the churchyard rests on his grave, and a suicide's grave is where the Count goes to ground when he lands.
joseph: Not a character: the name comes from the Hospital of St. Joseph and Ste. Mary in Buda-Pesth, where Jonathan is nursed.
thomas_snelling: Joseph Smollet's mate, a carrier's man in Bethnal Green who helped move the Count's boxes but is too drunk to remember anything, one of the dead ends in the hunt for the boxes.
vincent: A doctor at the North Hospital who treats the children bitten on Hampstead Heath by the "bloofer lady", the first sign to Van Helsing and Seward that Lucy has risen.
arminius: Van Helsing's friend at Buda-Pesth University, who traces the Count back to the Voivode Dracula who fought the Turks and whose family studied in the devil's school, the Scholomance. Through him the hunters learn who their enemy was and how formidable his mind is.
attila: Attila the Hun, whose blood the Count boasts runs in his veins as he tells Jonathan of his warrior race.
john_paxton: Two people share this name in the book: a sailor drowned off Cape Farewell, named on a Whitby gravestone, and the President of the Incorporated Law Society, who sends a representative to Mr. Hawkins's funeral.
patrick_hennessey: A doctor who looks after Seward's asylum while Seward is away. His report of Renfield attacking the carriers at Carfax is an early sign that the Count's boxes are being moved.
rufus_smith: An agent at Lloyd's in London who telegraphs Lord Godalming with news of the Czarina Catherine, keeping the hunters on the Count's trail across Europe.
shakespeare: Not a character: William Shakespeare, quoted by Jonathan (Hamlet's "My tablets!") and by Renfield.
bersicker: A grey wolf that escapes from the Zoological Gardens and smashes the window of Lucy's room, frightening her mother to death and leaving Lucy open to the Count. He turns up the next morning, tame again, with a cut head.
demeter: The Russian schooner from Varna that carries the Count to Whitby. Its log records the crew vanishing one by one, and it runs aground in a storm with its dead captain lashed to the wheel.
